## [1.3.0](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0) (2026-11-07)

### ✨ New Features

* unlock and expand playback speed controls ([3c966bc](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/3c966bc3ad3992dbc4c0f56e51bf64085fc950a0))

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Removes FLAG_SECURE from membership card and Compose dialogs to permit screenshots and disables Android 14+ screen capture detection in the Arc reader.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Blocks Segment and Mux events, disables Firebase Analytics after consent updates, denies automatic Crashlytics uploads and selects disabled Datadog setup. SDK initialization, queued Segment events, local metadata, Firebase collection before consent updates, local crash recording and explicit report submission remain; independent Braze and Singular behavior is unchanged.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Unhides the player's speed menu and fills it out to 0.5x-2.0x.

patches.name: Proxy token requests
patches.description: Routes token acquisition and refresh through your SOCKS proxy, with optional proxy authentication.

options.description: Hostname or IP address only, without scheme, credentials, or port. Use brackets for IPv6.
Explicit port from 1 to 65535. Enter as a string when using a JSON options file.
Optional printable ASCII username (1–255 characters). Credentials are embedded in the patched APK. Leave both credential fields blank for no authentication.
Optional printable ASCII password (1–255 characters). Credentials are embedded in the patched APK. Supply both username and password together.
Logs token HTTP status and exception class names only, under MorpheTokenProxy. Enable for troubleshooting.
